name: The Wild Titan
summary: Jory Delve's family went up the pass and did not come down. The Wild Titan walks the high ridges.

closes.when: flag.moonfall_started and flag.moonfall_nights_left <= 0 and not flag.moonfall_fled

stages.journal: The Howlers roar and throw rocks down on the mining hamlets; no fire burns near the peaks. The mountain itself seems to have woken.
stages.hint: Ask around the region for how to find it: its hook-giver, and the one who knows its secret.

stages.journal: We found where The Wild Titan lairs. There may be a way to hurt it more than the usual.
stages.hint: Learn its weakness from the one who knows it, or go straight to its lair.

stages.journal: We carry what hurts The Wild Titan. Time to go to its lair.
The Wild Titan is dead. The moon's gaze moves to Maidenmist Cemetery.
The nights ran out before it fell.
